7909.title: Modified shortcut matching lacks active-layout context
7909.rootCauseOneLine: Alt plus an ASCII event character bypasses physical-key fallback, so a KeyS event carrying Z cannot match the S binding.
7909.proposedFix: Provide validated active-layout base-key context while retaining Latin typed-letter behavior and consistent core/plugin/recorder semantics; validate desktop macOS availability and fallback policy before implementation.
7909.caveats: Both clean trusted-main runs reproduce the matcher failure. Native macOS event generation and composer Undo were not exercised on Linux. Full builds encountered an unrelated installed Plugin SDK dist failure. No safe simple fix or pull request was attempted.
